items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the last lesson I had with Roger Smith, he says, “Okay Mac, this is your last lesson.

ctx.x: What was it like being black-­

Oh! Once I hit the New York scene, they were the best. I was learning from them. Good education is a two way street. It’s interesting, the last lesson I had with Roger Smith, he says, “Okay Mac, this is your last lesson. I want you to play one note and show me everything I taught you.” He says, “Make it easy, the easiest note on the horn: the middle B flat.” So, I start to play and I check myself, “What’s he looking for.” And it quietly dawned on me. He wants to hear are you getting the sound the instrument was…
Was he happy when you finished playing that note?
